args: Fix the docs/site pull so it mirrors the upstream tree instead of accumulating: extract-docs-site-cli.mjs must clear content/<slug>/site/ before writing the freshly-pulled pages, so a page deleted/renamed upstream (e.g. fab-kit's stale docs/site/README.md, already gone upstream but stranded at content/fab-kit/site/README.md rendering at /tools/fab-kit/README) is removed locally and git add -A stages the deletion. Today the CLI only mkdir+writeFile per pulled page and never removes stale files, so the pull is purely additive — confirmed: git add -A content/ cannot stage a deletion the CLI never makes in the working tree. Clearing on an empty/no-tree pull is safe because the workflow only invokes the CLI when the tarball fetch succeeded (fetch failure → continue, keeps last-good); so 'CLI runs with zero files' means the repo genuinely has no docs/site now. Also delete the existing stray content/fab-kit/site/README.md. change_type: fix.
